We should create a Fed for AI.

The WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak in Africa a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. I spoke with former White House COVID-19 Response Coordinator in the Biden administration @ashishkjha about the scale of the outbreak and the extent to which it has been worsened by the Trump admin's international aid cuts.
